entries.title: Frenzy Boar
entries.summary: Listen for the hoof scrape and snort. The charge is the encounter’s most recognizable cue.

sections.title: Encounter
paragraphs: The client includes distinct sound cues for scraping, snorting, charging, skidding, and crashing. On the beta server, the timing, reach, and damage of these actions still need confirmation.
Boarrun Dell is a named biome in the client. Frenzy Boar spawn locations still need to be verified in game.

sections.title: Loot and gear
paragraphs: The client links a Tuskbite Ring loot rule to the Frenzy Boar. The ring’s availability and drop rate on the beta server are unknown.
Frenzy Boar Tusks are listed as a material in the Boarfang Blade recipe.

entries.title: Illfang the Kobold Lord
entries.summary: A named boss with several gear associations in the client.

sections.title: Encounter
paragraphs: Illfang is listed among the client’s boss entities. The beta encounter’s entrance, phases and party requirements still need confirmation.

sections.title: Loot and gear
paragraphs: Client loot rules associate Illfang with Kobold Lord’s Phantom, Usurper’s Buckler and Warlord’s Horn. Live availability and drop rates are unknown.

entries.title: Dune Scorpion
entries.summary: A desert creature named in the client’s creature data.

sections.title: Encounter
paragraphs: The client contains a Dune Scorpion animation definition. Its live spawn area, attack timing and drops still need confirmation.

entries.title: Canopy Prowler
entries.summary: Its client attack animations include a bite, paw rake, and pounce.

sections.title: Encounter
paragraphs: The client names bite, paw rake and pounce animations. Their names identify moves to watch for. Damage, tells and live spawn areas are still unverified.

entries.title: Boarfang Blade
entries.summary: A forged weapon that uses Frenzy Boar Tusks. The client lists an equip requirement of level 3.

sections.title: Forging recipe
paragraphs: The client recipe lists tier 3 and 180 forging XP. Confirm the recipe at a forge on your server build.

entries.title: Tuskbite Ring
entries.summary: A ring linked to the Frenzy Boar in a client loot rule.

sections.title: Acquisition
paragraphs: The installed client points from Frenzy Boar loot to a Tuskbite Ring table. The rule gives no drop rate and live availability still needs confirmation.

entries.title: Frenzy Boar Tusk
entries.summary: The Boarfang Blade forge recipe calls for two tusks.

sections.title: Uses
paragraphs: The packaged Boarfang Blade recipe uses two Frenzy Boar Tusks. Live drop behavior and quantities still need confirmation.

entries.title: Revive Crystal
entries.summary: The client describes a time-limited revival item for hardcore worlds. Check server rules before relying on it.

sections.title: Revival
paragraphs: The client interface describes use on a recently fallen player within 30 seconds and 12 blocks. It lists a cost of one crystal and a return at 25% HP.
Check whether your server mode enables the crystal and where you can obtain one.

entries.title: Stachion
entries.summary: A named town with related outdoor landmarks and a labyrinth.

sections.title: Around Stachion
paragraphs: The client names Lake Talpha, the Shattered Terraces, the Ravines, Galey Heights, the Goskai Cliffs, and Stachion Labyrinth. Access and routes are still being mapped.

entries.title: Lake Talpha
entries.summary: A lake named among the Stachion locations in the client.

sections.title: Finding the lake
paragraphs: The client labels this landmark under Stachion. The route, nearby enemies and travel hazards still need confirmation.

entries.title: Stachion Labyrinth
entries.summary: A named labyrinth associated with Stachion.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Stachion Labyrinth appears among the client’s named locations. The entrance, access requirements and encounters still need confirmation.

entries.title: Boarrun Dell
entries.summary: A named biome to identify in the field.

sections.title: Exploration
paragraphs: The packaged biome has empty spawn lists. Creature encounters and the route to Boarrun Dell still need to be confirmed in game.

entries.title: Death & revival
entries.summary: Check the beta’s death rules before staking a run on revival.

sections.title: Before a fight
bullets: Check the current rules for the server and mode you are playing.
Confirm whether party members can use Revive Crystals and how they are obtained.
Agree on a retreat route and when to disengage.

sections.title: Revive Crystal
paragraphs: The client describes a 30-second use window, a 12-block range and revival at 25% HP in hardcore worlds. The current server rules and crystal availability still need confirmation.

entries.title: First-session checklist
entries.summary: A short checklist to run through before leaving a safe area.

sections.title: Before leaving town
bullets: Check the current death and party rules.
Review your dash, block or parry, map and party-ping controls.
Mark a confirmed safe location and agree on how to get back.
Choose a piece of starting gear and check its level requirement.

sections.title: In the field
bullets: Watch a new enemy’s attack cues from a safe position.
Record useful routes and landmarks as you confirm them.

entries.title: Forging
entries.summary: Read recipes with forging and equipment requirements in mind.

sections.title: Reading a recipe
paragraphs: Client recipe data lists ingredients, a forging level and a tier. Equipment can have a separate equip level.
The client’s forging interface cues the player to strike when the ring closes. Check the live recipe and station before committing materials.
